summary.zh: 这一版继续完善 Pinging fork 发版链路：没有 Apple 签名证书时跳过 macOS 构建，不再挡住 Windows/Linux 安装包和热更新发布。
summary.en: Keeps the Pinging fork release pipeline moving: skip macOS builds when Apple signing certs are absent so Windows/Linux installers and hot updates can still publish.

title.zh: 无 Apple 证书时跳过 macOS，放行 Windows 发版
title.en: Skip macOS without Apple certs so Windows releases can ship

summary.zh: fork 没有 CSC_LINK 时不再因 macOS keychain 步骤失败而跳过 release/publish-train。
summary.en: Without CSC_LINK, macOS keychain failures no longer skip release/publish-train on this fork.

details.zh: 矩阵暂时只保留 Windows 与 Linux；校验清单也改为不强制要求 mac 产物。
details.en: Matrix temporarily keeps Windows and Linux only; release verification no longer requires mac assets.
